name: cache-meter
description: Band: time left on the warm cache, hit rate, context as weather with its trend over 12 turns, plan limits, compact and keep-warm buttons; stops one send to a cold cache and names its cost (Cache Tax runs inside).

ttlMinutes.title: Cache Meter: cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: 60 on a subscription (Pro/Max), 5 for the API's default cache.

limits.title: Cache Meter: show plan limits
limits.description: Usage of the 5-hour and the weekly window.

guard.title: Cache Meter: cold-cache guard
guard.description: refuse: stop one send to a cold cache with a large context and name the cost (send again to pay). warn: only show the cost. off.

keepWarmHours.title: Cache Meter: keep warm for … hours
keepWarmHours.description: How long the keep-warm button keeps the cache warm (one small request over the cache about every 50 minutes of idle).

autoWarm.title: Cache Meter: keep warm after a cold write
autoWarm.description: on: after a paid cold write, keep the cache warm for 3 hours by itself (costs tokens).

autoCompact.title: Cache Meter: auto-compact at
autoCompact.description: Sets Claude Code's autoCompactWindow. On 1M-context models Claude only compacts by itself at about 967k tokens, and every turn re-reads the whole context until then. auto = Claude's default.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
